summary: Multi-tenant analytics dashboard with auth, charts and a settings area

architecture.backend: Next.js route handlers -> service layer -> Prisma repository; tenant id resolved in middleware
architecture.frontend: App Router; React Server Components for data, client components for interactivity, TanStack Query for mutations
architecture.designSystem: Tailwind tokens, shadcn/ui components, 4px spacing scale, dark mode via CSS variables
notes: the RSC vs client-component boundary was decided per route during the architecture interview

workflows.notes: one agent per Prisma model + API contract

lessons: Resolving the tenant id in one middleware, decided during the architecture interview, kept every downstream agent from re-implementing tenant scoping.
Verified-swarm on the frontend caught components that rendered a spinner forever instead of handling the empty state.
Pinning the Prisma and Next.js versions via context7 before synthesis stopped agents mixing pages-router and app-router APIs.
pitfalls: An early run skipped the backend-contract phase and frontend agents invented API shapes; adding it as an explicit phase fixed the drift.
